purpose: Pre-register the RLPD-vs-SAC prediction and its mechanism BEFORE any training curve exists, so the comparison cannot be rationalised after the fact.

mechanism.reward_is_sparse_and_spiky: per-transition reward in the demo buffer: median -0.030 (step cost), max 28.72; stage bonuses fire in single transitions
mechanism.rlpd_batch_composition: batch 8 at DEMO_FRAC 0.5 -> 4 demo samples per update
mechanism.interpretation: ~52% of RLPD updates contain at least one high-reward demo transition; SAC only sees such signal when its own exploration produces it

predictions.primary: RLPD reaches the lift stage at fewer online environment interactions than SAC
predictions.secondary: RLPD full-success rate exceeds SAC at a matched online interaction budget
predictions.sft_reference: SFT reaches reach/grasp but not lift, on the held-out suite
predictions.falsifier: if SAC matches RLPD interactions-to-first-lift, the demonstration prior confers no sample-efficiency advantage on this task
predictions.also_interesting: SAC catching up at a larger budget would be a meaningful negative result for the prior, not a failed experiment

what_would_invalidate_the_comparison: either arm oscillating rather than learning (the failure mode of both earlier pilots)
alpha collapsing monotonically (now guarded: target -8.4 is inside the achievable range)
evaluation on the canonical single reset instead of the 50-condition held-out suite
fixed_and_not_to_be_tuned_per_arm: the 22-episode demonstration prior (selected by replayability, never by RL outcome)
